title: set_cookie straight up broken

- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc).

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
@app.post("/path")
async def path(request: Request, response: Response):

    text = (await request.body()).decode("utf-8")
    if True:
        response.set_cookie(
            key="loggedIn",
            value=passwordHash,
            max_age=34560000,
            httponly=True,     
            secure=False,
            samesite="lax" 
        )
        return PlainTextResponse(content="correct")
    else:
        return PlainTextResponse(content="wrong")
```


### Description

The browser never receives the cookie, the above code is triggered via fetch() from client side
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f3976857-24ef-4b96-81e6-bfb85fe024de)

It seems to be a bug?

EDIT: 
I just tested out manually setting the cookie header and it works perfectly. Most likely a bug

Windows

answer.body:
Hello @Zhoros, 
when you return directly an instance of `Response `, in your case `PlainTextResponse`, this is the one that will be used and the one declared in dependecy will be ignored. 
To look at it from another perspective: if a `Response` is declared as a dependency, it will be used to construct the final response together with the value returned by the endpoint. If, instead, an instance of Response is returned directly, that will be taken as the final response.

Hope this helps.
